name: 迪莫弗斯
fact: The first celestial body whose orbit was deliberately altered by humans. NASA's DART struck Dimorphos at 6.14 km/s on 2022-09-26, shortening its 11.9-hour orbit around Didymos by 33 minutes (4.2%) — exceeding the success threshold by ~25× and demonstrating planetary defense is possible.
bio: 160-m moonlet of 65803 Didymos, discovered 2003. The DART surface turned out to be 'rubble-pile fluid' — the spacecraft sank ~50 cm into the surface during the half-second of contact, and the momentum-transfer enhancement factor β ≈ 3.6 indicated significant carry from ejected surface material. The CubeSat LICIACube imaged the plume in real time; HST and JWST observed the ejecta tail for weeks.

links.l: Daly et al. (2023) — Successful kinetic impact (Nature)
